description: Fixture-driven eval harness that produces per-pack JSON+MD reports and enforces hard trust gates (schema validity, citation integrity, failure journeys).

userStories.title: Run Fixture Evals Locally
userStories.description: As a developer, I can run fixture:eval for a pack and get a deterministic report so I can catch regressions before demos.
acceptanceCriteria: fixture:eval pack_01_clean produces per-pack JSON + Markdown reports and a cross-pack summary table.
fixture:eval pack_02_missing_rea confirms expected missing_input journeys (missing docs -> missing_input).
Runner outputs are deterministic for the same inputs (no flaky ordering or randomness).

userStories.title: Enforce Hard Trust Gates
userStories.description: As a developer, I get a clear pass/fail on schema validity, citation integrity, and failure journeys so we never ship a broken trust moment.
acceptanceCriteria: Hard gates align with docs/03-architecture/60_observability_and_evals.md: schema validity (100%), citation integrity (100%), failure journeys.
Citation integrity checks validate cited page exists, polygons exist, and snippet_hash matches canonical normalization rule.
Runner exits non-zero if any hard gate fails (even if CI is report-only initially).

userStories.title: Publish Eval Reports In CI (Report-Only)
userStories.description: As a developer, CI uploads eval reports so reviewers can see regressions without running the harness locally.
acceptanceCriteria: CI job runs fixture:eval and uploads JSON/MD outputs as build artefacts.
CI prints or posts a concise summary table (pass/fail + key counts) for quick scanning.
CI runtime is bounded; if it exceeds a budget, the job fails with clear output.
